question: The Bhitari Pillar inscription of which Gupta ruler narrates his fight with the Pushyamitras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skandgupta**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bhitari Pillar inscription **narrating the fight with Pushyamitras belongs to** Skandagupta**.
 
• The Bhitari Pillar inscription provides historical information about Skandagupta, a ruler of the Gupta Empire.
 
• Skandagupta, the son of Kumaragupta I, ascended the Gupta throne around 455 CE. His reign faced significant challenges, including invasions by the Pushyamitras and the Hunas.
 
• **Chandragupta II** : Chandragupta II, also known as Chandragupta Vikramaditya, was a prominent ruler of the Gupta Empire known for his military successes and cultural patronage.
